title: Appropriate Laboratory
description: Definition of Appropriate Laboratory under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a laboratory or an organisation— (i) recognised by the Central Government; or (ii) recognised by a State Government, subject to such guidelines as may be issued by the Central Government in this behalf; or (iii) established by or under any law for the time being in force, which is maintained, financed or aided by the Central Government or a State Government for carrying out analysis or test of any goods with a view to determining whether such goods suffer from any defect
content.plain_language: a laboratory that is approved by the central or state government to test goods for defects
examples: A government-funded lab that checks food products for contamination
A private lab recognised by the state government to test electronic goods for safety

user_queries: How is a lab recognised by the government?
What kind of labs can test goods for defects?
